tools.name: check_deal_affordability
tools.description: Test whether a business acquisition supports its debt. Takes the purchase price, the seller's stated earnings, the buyer's equity share and loan terms; returns the cash flow after a market salary and capex, the senior loan, the annual debt service, the debt service coverage ratio (DSCR) against an i

tools.name: build_capital_stack
tools.description: Lay out sources and uses for a business acquisition and solve the senior loan as the remainder. Takes the price, working capital, closing costs, buyer and other equity, a seller note with its terms, senior loan terms and annual cash flow; returns the funding gap, each source as a share of total uses

tools.name: model_acquisition_loan
tools.description: Compute the payment and amortization of a senior acquisition loan. Takes the principal, the rate, the term and the amortization period, with an optional annual cash flow for a coverage check; returns the monthly payment, first-year debt service, total interest, any balloon at maturity and the DSCR w

tools.name: model_seller_note
tools.description: Model seller financing in a business acquisition: amortizing or interest-only, with optional standby months and interest treatment. Returns the monthly payment, the first full amortizing year of service, the balloon due at maturity, total interest, the share of the price the note carries and coverag

tools.name: normalize_sde_valuation
tools.description: Normalize a seller's earnings into seller's discretionary earnings (SDE), itemizing each add-back with a conservative case alongside, then bridge to cash flow available for debt service and apply a multiple range the user supplies. Returns claimed SDE, conservative SDE, excluded double-counted adjus

tools.name: screen_sba_eligibility
tools.description: Screen a business acquisition against baseline SBA 7(a) requirements: ownership citizenship, loan size, for-profit US operation, size standard, change of ownership, existing SBA debt, equity injection, seller note standby and credit elsewhere. Returns each rule as pass, review or constraint, with it
